segments.text: Check your system under pressure for leaks prior to using the contents of the gas cylinder.
segments.zh: 在使用气瓶中的气体之前，要在带压状态下检查系统是否泄漏。

segments.text: Confirm the integrity of the connection by using a bubble test or electronic leak detection instrument.
segments.zh: 用气泡测试或电子检漏仪确认接头的完好性。

segments.text: Never use a flame to check for leaks.
Refer to your laboratory SOP to make sure your method and procedure is compatible with the gas being tested.
segments.zh: 请参阅你们实验室的 SOP，确保你的方法和程序与所测试的气体相容。

segments.text: A bubble test is performed with SNOOP or a
segments.zh: 气泡测试使用 SNOOP 或

segments.text: compatible commercial leak test solution or mild soap solution in a wash bottle.
segments.zh: 相容的商用检漏液，或者装在洗瓶中的温和肥皂水进行。

segments.text: Apply the solution to the inlet valve and outlet flow valve connections.
segments.zh: 把溶液涂在进气阀和出口流量阀的接头上。

segments.text: Any active bubbles indicate a leak in your system.
segments.zh: 任何持续冒出的气泡都说明系统存在泄漏。

segments.text: Please note the soap and water may be corrosive to metal fittings.
segments.zh: 请注意，肥皂和水可能会腐蚀金属配件。

segments.text: Electronic leak detection instruments must be maintained and calibrated to ensure accuracy.
segments.zh: 电子检漏仪必须经过维护和校准，以确保准确。

segments.text: Read, understand, and follow the meter's operation manual before use.
segments.zh: 使用前要阅读、理解并遵循仪表的操作手册。

segments.text: If leaks are discovered in your system, depressurize, tighten, and then recheck the connections.
segments.zh: 如果发现系统有泄漏，要先泄压、拧紧，然后重新检查接头。

segments.text: If a leak continues, notify your laboratory supervisor as soon as possible.
segments.zh: 如果泄漏仍然存在，请尽快通知你的实验室主管。

segments.text: Maintain a system inspection schedule to log the cylinder leak tests.
segments.zh: 制定系统检查计划，记录气瓶的泄漏测试。

segments.text: Refer to your laboratory SOP for how to keep and maintain this log.
segments.zh: 关于如何保存和维护这份记录，请参阅你们实验室的 SOP。
